== Notes ==
* Combine with [[Bloodsong]] or [[Vampirism]]  to gain additional life stealing without damage reduction.
* Can be used to make up for [[Wanderlust]]'s health loss.
* The effect is applied on skill activation on spirits within range. It is not applied to spirits summoned and/or brought within earshot after skill activation.
* Heroes use this skill inefficiently in builds with multiple spirits, activating it before they have summoned all spirits available to them.

== Trivia ==
* Unlike other skills with [[Aura]] in their name, it is not an [[Enchantment spell]]. However, it was one until the [[Game updates/20090618|June 19, 2009 update]].
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
